activity.notes: Ibrahim Rugova was elected President of Kosovo by the Assembly on 4 March 2002 and remained in office until his death on 21 January 2006. ATLAS uses this post-war institutional presidency under the UN-administered/self-government framework as the representative Activity. His earlier 1992 election as president of the parallel Republic of Kosovo is preserved as historical context but is not added as a second Activity here so that distinct institutional contexts are not flattened together.

sources.title: Dr. Ibrahim Rugova – Former President of Kosovo
sources.citation_text: The official Presidency of Kosovo biography records Rugova's election as President in March 2002, his re-election in 2004, and his death on 21 January 2006.

sources.title: Prime Minister Kurti commemorates President Ibrahim Rugova
sources.citation_text: The Government of Kosovo records that Rugova was elected President by the Assembly on 4 March 2002 and distinguishes that office from his earlier parallel-state presidency.
